text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angola press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Portugal's Defence Minister Antonio Vitorino signed a military cooperation agreement with Angola's Defence Minister Pedro Sebastiao. Vitorino will meet President Jose Eduardo dos Santos before completing his visit to Angola on Friday.
- an accord for the exploration of six terminals was signed between the Port of Luanda and concessionaires including Cabotang, Angonave, Secil Maritima and Unicargas.
- Angola's finance and industry ministries said they had decided to establish maximum prices for the sale of wheat flour and bread.
